phase_context: Addition of a selected reference apparatus to the Stage-4 Part B-1 condensed submission form, before the T10 freeze
authority: Explicit operator instruction 2026-09-04: take the references from final_exports/FIELDWISE_Part_B1_manual-condensed_2026-08-30.docx, selecting only the top six or seven for space
decision: Six references were selected from the 2026-08-30 master's 18 footnotes (~30 works) and added through tools/build_partb1_condensed.py as an end-of-document References block at 8.5pt with bracketed in-text markers [1]-[6]. Entries are copied verbatim from the 08-30 footnote text. Two slots were mandatory because the condensed text names them inline (Carucci et al. 2023, Badr et al. 2026, the 8-30% water-savings bound in 2.3). The other four anchor the most evaluator-challengeable methodological claims: Velazquez-Chavez et al. 2024 (spectral proxies rarely tested against plant response, 1.1 Pertinence), Roberts et al. 2017 (blocked unseen-year validation, 1.1 Measurability), Gneiting et al. 2007 (pre-registered calibration metrics, 1.1 Measurability), Murphy 1993 (decision value over retrospective accuracy, 1.2). Meyer et al. 2018 was considered and dropped: its claim overlaps the Roberts anchor, and six entries protect the 10-page budget better than seven.

artifact.note: Citation markers [n] are pointers, not prose, and are excluded from the 5450-word cap; the References block (6 entries, 156 words, 8.5pt, ~0.3 page) is counted and reported separately. The operator's Word print-layout <=10-page check now also covers this block. The T10 freeze hash remains the operator's sign-off on 2026-09-06.

traceability: All six entries originate in the 2026-08-30 condensed master's footnotes, which carry the drafting-era literature apparatus of the run-03 Tier 5 sections; no new work was introduced and no bibliographic detail was altered. The Univer figures in 2.3 remain 'citation pending, flagged' - unchanged by this decision and still owed by the operator.
self_check_added: The builder now fails if: the references block is absent or duplicated, entries fall outside 6-7, any entry lacks a doi, in-text markers do not exactly match entries 1..n, or a named in-text citation (Carucci, Badr) lacks an entry.
constitutional_basis: §11.1 (evaluator-facing substantiation of contested claims), §11.4 (references trace to the existing Tier 5 master, no new facts), §9.4 (this record).
